title: Atomic writes
hints: Never write into the real file directly: if the source fails halfway, the old contents are already gone. Write a temporary file next to it instead, with os.CreateTemp(filepath.Dir(path), ".tmp-*").
Copy into the temp file, then Sync and Close it, and only then os.Rename it over path. A rename within one directory replaces the file in one step.
On any error, close and os.Remove the temporary file so nothing is left behind. A deferred func that checks a named err result keeps this tidy.
